name: superpills
description: Send carousels to TikTok as drafts, schedule posts that wait for your OK, and see each account's daily views.

interface.longDescription:
Superpills schedules your social posts and tracks your views. Make a carousel with ChatGPT, and ChatGPT sends it to your TikTok inbox as a draft. Open TikTok, add a sound and post it yourself. Ask ChatGPT to plan next week's posts, and each one waits in your Superpills calendar until you approve it. Every morning Superpills counts your views, so ChatGPT can tell you which posts worked.

Nothing ChatGPT makes is published without you.

Once connected, ChatGPT can:
- Send a carousel of up to 35 photos to your TikTok inbox as a draft.
- Schedule a post with text, photos or a video to up to 30 connected accounts at once. On TikTok it arrives as a draft too.
- See each account's daily views and find your most-viewed posts.
- Check or cancel scheduled posts, and confirm a draft reached TikTok.

TikTok, Pinterest and Google Business Profile work today. Instagram, Facebook, Threads, YouTube and LinkedIn company pages are waiting for each network to approve Superpills.

You sign in with your Superpills account, so ChatGPT never sees your social media passwords.
defaultPrompt: Make a 5-slide carousel about our new menu and send it to my TikTok as a draft.
How many views did my TikTok accounts get this week?
Plan three posts for next week and leave them waiting for my OK.

positive.prompt: Which social accounts do I have connected in Superpills?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists each brand (workspace) and its connected accounts, with the network of each one.

positive.prompt: How many views did my TikTok accounts get in the last 7 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows views per day and per account for the last 7 days. An account shows 0 on the day it was connected, because there is no earlier count to subtract.

positive.prompt: What were my five most-viewed posts this month?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists up to five posts ordered by views, with the link and caption of each.

positive.description: Send a TikTok draft and check that it arrived
positive.prompt: Send these 3 images to my TikTok account as a draft with the caption 'Test carousel', then check that it arrived: https://superpills.app/demo/slide-1.png https://superpills.app/demo/slide-2.png https://superpills.app/demo/slide-3.png
positive.expected_behavior: The carousel reaches the TikTok inbox as a draft (status SEND_TO_USER_INBOX). Nothing is published.

positive.description: Schedule a post that waits for approval
positive.prompt: Schedule this photo on my TikTok account for tomorrow at 6 pm and leave it waiting for my OK: https://superpills.app/demo/slide-1.png
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a post that waits for the person's OK in the Superpills calendar. It doesn't go out until it is approved.

negative.description: Superpills can't publish to TikTok directly from ChatGPT; ChatGPT should explain that it can send a draft or schedule a post that waits for the OK.
negative.prompt: Publish this video on TikTok right now, without a draft.

negative.description: Superpills only sees the accounts the person connected; ChatGPT shouldn't return data about other people's accounts.
negative.prompt: Show me the views of @someoneelse's TikTok account.

negative.description: Superpills doesn't read or answer comments; ChatGPT should say so instead of calling a tool.
negative.prompt: Reply to the comments on my last Instagram post.

publication.release_notes: First version: TikTok drafts, posts that wait for approval, and daily views.

es-419.subtitle: Borradores de TikTok y vistas
es-419.description:
Superpills programa tus posts en redes y cuenta tus vistas. Armas un carrusel con ChatGPT y ChatGPT lo manda a tu bandeja de TikTok como borrador. Abres TikTok, le pones sonido y lo publicas tú. Le pides a ChatGPT que planee los posts de la próxima semana y cada uno espera en tu calendario de Superpills hasta que lo apruebes. Cada mañana Superpills cuenta tus vistas, así ChatGPT te dice qué posts funcionaron.

Nada de lo que hace ChatGPT se publica sin ti.

Con Superpills conectado, ChatGPT puede:
- Mandar a tu bandeja de TikTok un carrusel de hasta 35 fotos, como borrador.
- Programar un post con texto, fotos o un video en hasta 30 cuentas a la vez. En TikTok también llega como borrador.
- Ver las vistas diarias de cada cuenta y encontrar tus posts con más vistas.
- Revisar o cancelar posts programados y confirmar que un borrador llegó a TikTok.

TikTok, Pinterest y Google Business Profile ya funcionan. Instagram, Facebook, Threads, YouTube y las páginas de empresa de LinkedIn esperan que cada red apruebe Superpills.

Inicias sesión con tu cuenta de Superpills, así ChatGPT nunca ve las contraseñas de tus redes.
